definition: 100% means a completed playable PSP recompilation across the agreed original-game scope, not generated-code coverage.
reason: No reliable global completion percentage is established yet

gates.name: Original-game scope
gates.evidence: A complete original PSP feature/mode checklist is not yet signed off.

gates.name: Native translation
gates.evidence: 250 generated units verified; one unsupported candidate remains excluded. This only establishes static coverage.

gates.name: PSP runtime services
gates.evidence: 35 bounded kernel checks pass. 203/252 source bindings are not proof of complete required PSP service behavior.

gates.name: Campaign and activities
gates.evidence: Benjamin reports the first two story missions completed. Remaining missions, activities and mini-games lack comprehensive validation.

gates.name: Rendering and audio
gates.evidence: Observed in tested sequences; broader PSP rendering/audio comparisons remain open.

gates.name: Controls and saves
gates.evidence: Controller and savedata worked in bounded tests. Wider input and save/load regression coverage remains open.

gates.name: Stability and performance
gates.evidence: Boot synchronization fixes are integrated; dense-driving frametimes remain irregular and repeatability needs broader testing.

gates.name: Reproducible local setup
gates.evidence: The prepared Windows Playtest works; a complete documented fresh local setup from the owner ISO remains to be packaged.

known_blockers: The rest of the campaign and original feature/mode scope are not validated.
Required PSP service semantics remain incomplete or unaudited; source-name bindings are insufficient evidence.
Dense driving scenes have reported drops toward 20 FPS and unstable frametimes.
A known code/data candidate and dynamic callback coverage still need review.
